selection_rule: Collaborator seeds first, then article-type retrieval review in saved queue order.
constraints: Metadata type and title terms do not establish scientific eligibility.
The source pass records geography separately from overall eligibility.
An eligible or excluded decision requires exact source-bound evidence.
An abstract or landing page is not full-text evidence.
Missing access remains pending and is not an exclusion.
Unknown correction or retraction coverage remains unknown.
All selected records remain in the versioned overlay.
